notes.title: Achievement Bugfix (1.2.2)
notes.notes:
Just a small update to fix some achievements that would not trigger for some players. This update introduces a "Sync Steamworks" option in the settings menu which can be used to re-trigger any missed achievements.

If you've been missing 100% because of this, we're sorry! Hopefully this update helps.

Thankyou all for playing,
Ben & Ricky

notes.title: Post-Release Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you so much to all of you who've played the game so far. We've been overwhelmed by just how well received the game has been by reviewers, streamers and players alike. We've had some wonderful reviews, and even scored an honourable mention at the 2018 Freeplay Awards (Australia's Independent Games Awards), which just blows us away.

It's been an absolutely crazy time, but we've got more good stuff coming from TwoPM Studios. There are some miscellaneous small changes in this update, the biggest being a new tracking system to fix some bugs & crashes. For anyone who is interested, we've also written a post-mortem about the release of The Thin Silence - you can have a peak behind the curtain and learn a little about the inner working and future plans of TwoPM.

 Read the Post-mortem 

We've got more behind the scenes writing planned and we're taking the time to consider our next projects.

Much love,
Ben & Ricky

Follow us on Twitter for updates: @vivavolt @iammonshushu
